content.short: Corporate cards, spend and cross-border finance platform.
content.description: Jeeves is a global business finance platform that gives startups and growing companies corporate cards, expense management, accounts payable, and cross-border payments from a single dashboard. Built to work across multiple countries and currencies, it lets businesses issue physical and virtual cards, pay vendors and bills internationally, earn cashback, and manage spend in local currencies without opening separate accounts in each market. Popular with companies operating in the United States, Latin America, and other regions, Jeeves positions itself as international banking infrastructure for global startups. Its combination of multi-currency cards, payments, and expense tooling makes reconciliation, approvals, and cross-border finance operations central to how customers run their businesses.
content.meta: Jeeves offers global corporate cards, expense management, and cross-border payments. Discover Jeeves and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
